comment: Written BEFORE any code reads NEEDS or OPENS (the W discipline). v0.40 is D51's declared half: NEEDS on a LANGUAGE, OPENS on a DECLARATION, the closed catalog of nine, A6's gate at the meta-court.

accepts.name: NEEDS two doors: a kind opens one by name, a kind opens what its seat lists
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.40", GRAMMAR "0.40", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q", NEEDS [network, process]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [network, process, filesystem], MESSAGE "a capability") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION listener AS (VERB "LISTENER", SEATS [host: text?], OPENS network) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [host: text?, needs: [caps]?], OPENS needs) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a language with neither NEEDS nor OPENS is what it was
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.40", GRAMMAR "0.40", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [network, process, filesystem], MESSAGE "a capability") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION note AS (VERB "NOTE", SEATS [text: text?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: an OPENS seat's MENU may list a door the language does not NEED (the sentence that uses it is refused)
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.40", GRAMMAR "0.40", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q", NEEDS [network]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [network, process, filesystem], MESSAGE "a capability") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [host: text?, needs: [caps]?], OPENS needs) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a kind beside them that opens nothing
accepts.source:

DEFINE DECLARATION note AS (VERB "NOTE", SEATS [text: text?]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: NEEDS a word outside the nine
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.40", GRAMMAR "0.40", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q", NEEDS [network, internet]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU caps AS (WORDS [network, process, filesystem], MESSAGE "a capability") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION listener AS (VERB "LISTENER", SEATS [host: text?], OPENS network) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [host: text?, needs: [caps]?], OPENS needs) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: NEEDS: 'internet' is not a capability; the nine are filesystem, process, network, environment, dynamic_load, gpio, threads, clock, inference

rejects.refusal: listener OPENS network, and the LANGUAGE q does not NEED it

rejects.name: silence refuses: a kind OPENS and the language NEEDS nothing
rejects.source:
